title: Tour of the periodontal chart
summary: The parts of the periodontal chart sheet: steps, progress, probing, inspector and footer.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide goes on when their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient.

steps.title: Periodontal chart
steps.details: Opens a new periodontal chart: missing teeth, pontics and implants come from the latest odontogram, and the latest closed chart with probing is the guide (a screening never is).

steps.title: Header
steps.details: Patient, chart number, date and doctor.

steps.title: The four steps
steps.details: Probing, Progress, Diagnosis and Closing. You can jump between steps at any time; a finished one has a tick.

steps.title: Progress and status
steps.details: The ring says how complete it is; the status is worked out by the system and saving is automatic.

steps.title: What is missing
steps.details: Tap it to see the missing sites in amber on the chart.

steps.title: Exam bar
steps.details: Exam type, the guide exam, what came from the odontogram, settings and dictation.

steps.title: Passes
steps.details: Probing is done in three rounds: depth and bleeding, gingival margin, furcations and mobility.

steps.title: Periodontal chart
steps.details: Outer face on top, inner face below; blue margin curve and red pocket-bottom curve. Tap a cell to measure there.

steps.title: Inspector
steps.details: The active tooth with its table, the keypad, the marks and the note.

steps.title: Footer
steps.details: Back and next, always in the same place.
